comparison.objective: Place a pointer at a specified dial graduation; candidate tunes damping from observed carriage behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Pointer placement and angular alignment versus tool insertion, fastener release, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Pointer aligned to 120 degrees versus safe physical cycles meeting energy, velocity, travel, rebound, and drift requirements.
comparison.reason: Shared angular alignment is only a generic primitive; the candidate tests tool-mediated commissioning and closed-loop dynamic adjustment.
